topography.project_purpose: DTX is a decentralized derivatives and spot trading protocol on Blast, enabling users to trade perpetual futures and swap tokens through a unified liquidity and risk engine.
topography.relationship_narrative: All contracts belong to a single product family, DTX Derivatives, with core contracts handling trading, liquidity, and risk, while supporting contracts likely provide auxiliary services such as configuration or access control, all deployed by two distinct deployer clusters.
